{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
workspace=$(mktemp -d)
cp /etc/group "$workspace/groups_copy.txt"
stat -c 'permissions=%A mode=%a mtime=%y' "$workspace/groups_copy.txt" > "$workspace/groups_copy_meta.txt"
# extract non-comment non-empty lines
grep -v '^\s*#' "$workspace/groups_copy.txt" | sed '/^\s*$/d' > "$workspace/groups_nocomment.txt"
# create deduplicated sorted list of group names
cut -d: -f1 "$workspace/groups_nocomment.txt" | sort -u > "$workspace/groups_list.txt"
# placeholder for final numeric result
: > "$workspace/groups_count_meta.txt"
# verify the list matches non-comment entries deduplicated
if diff -q <(cut -d: -f1 "$workspace/groups_nocomment.txt" | sort -u) "$workspace/groups_list.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "verification=OK" > "$workspace/groups_list_verify.txt"
else
  echo "verification=FAIL" > "$workspace/groups_list_verify.txt"
  diff -u <(cut -d: -f1 "$workspace/groups_nocomment.txt" | sort -u) "$workspace/groups_list.txt" > "$workspace/groups_list_diff.txt" || true
fi
# compute count
count=$(wc -l < "$workspace/groups_list.txt" | tr -d '[:space:]')
# print workspace path to stderr for user's reference, and print count to stdout
echo "$workspace" >&2
printf "%s" "$count"
"}
